stem: Which sentence should replace sentence 33 to help Hana bring her story to a more effective closing?

options.label: A
options.text: Leilani had once grown a pineapple from a top, so she offered some tips to her mom and me.

options.label: B
options.text: It took us a little while to decide on the perfect place to plant the pineapple top.

options.label: C
options.text: I knew I was going to have to be patient, but my mouth was already beginning to water.

options.label: D
options.text: I was certain that Leilani and I were going to be good friends for a long, long time.

visual_elements: multiple choice with four options labeled A, B, C, D
